carretera-austral-coyhaique-villa-o-higg.story: A one-way ride of 920 km, Coyhaique to the finish - roughly 12 h 50 in the saddle. On the way it passes Cerro Castillo, Puerto Rio Tranquilo, Cochrane and Caleta Tortel. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It crosses from Chile into Argentina - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
